REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
THURSDAY - MAY 8, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Community Development Department at (562) 916-1201 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments will be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Commissioner or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

6.  New and Old Business

  6A. Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTIONOF
  THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2025-5, A
  PROPOSAL BY CLARKDALE ESTATE HOMES. LLC TO CONSTRUCT A NEW SINGLE-
  FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENTCOMPRISED OF FIVE (5) TWO-STORY
  RESIDENCESAND FIVE (5) ACCESSORYDWELLING UNITS. ADDITIONAL
  IMPROVEMENTS INCLUDE SIDEWALK. PARKWAY LANDSCAPE. AND RELATED SITE
  IMPROVEMENTS. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS LOCATED AT 17200-17224 CLARKDALE
  AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703 (APNS 7033-004-049, 7099-004-050,
  7033-004-0451, 7033-005-052, AND 7033-005-055).#

  8Pursuant to Section 153332 of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Senior Planner Jeremy Loh. A PowerPointpresentation
  was displayed, providing details about the previously-approved project under Precise
  Plan2020-5, and the reasoningfor the project moving forward in 2025. Mr. Loh
  continued his presentation of the proposed project and existing property conditions.
  The location is proposed to have five (5) new two-story residences and five (5)
  accessory dwelling units. Mr. Loh provided details of the proposed floor plans
  available to potential buyers. Discussion followed regarding the proximity of the
  closest park to the proposedproject and the design of the new residences,potential
  parking issues, the proximity to the neighboring school, and the timeframe in which
  the five (5) new two-story residencesand five (5) accessorydwelling units will be
  constructed. Mr. Lohconcludednoting that two (2) public commentswere received
  related to the proposed project.

  Chair Pulido opened the public hearing. Cerritos resident Kenneth Hitt commented on
  the vacant industrial building located acrossthe street from the project site, the
  amount of garbage peopledump, and the attraction of unhousedindividuals. Mr. Hitt
  reiterated that during the previous approval of this project, a privacy wall was to be
  built at the beginningstages of the building in order to keep peoplefrom coming in
  and out of their neighborhood.

  Mrs. Aguila stated that per the Conditions of Approval, the same would be required
  with the current project. The project architect, Shiv Talwar, and contractor, Ashu
  Sherman, provided comments on the assistant staff and made Them available to
  answer questions the Planning Commission may have. Seeing and hearing no other
  speakers, Chair Pulido declared the public hearing closed.

  MOTION: it was moved by Vice Chair Reyes and seconded by Commissioner Jhaveri
  to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2025-7: A RESOLUTIONOFTHE
